description: Implementation of VertexArrayMtl class methods for Metal renderer in ANGLE project, handling vertex and index buffer streaming, conversion, and setup.

classes.name: VertexArrayMtl
classes.description: Class implementing vertex array handling for Metal in ANGLE, including buffer streaming and conversion.

methods.name: StreamVertexData
methods.description: Streams vertex data into a buffer, handling format conversion.

methods.name: GetIndexConvertedBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates buffer size needed for index data after conversion.

methods.name: StreamIndexData
methods.description: Streams index data into a buffer, expanding unsigned byte indices to ushort if needed.

methods.name: GetVertexCount
methods.description: Calculates number of vertices based on buffer size and format.

methods.name: GetIndexCount
methods.description: Calculates number of indices based on buffer size and index type.

methods.name: SetDefaultVertexBufferLayout
methods.description: Sets default vertex buffer layout parameters.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes vertex array state with GPU buffers.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::setupDraw
methods.description: Prepares vertex array for drawing, setting up buffer layouts.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::updateClientAttribs
methods.description: Updates client-side vertex attributes for drawing.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::syncDirtyAttrib
methods.description: Syncs individual attribute state, handling buffer conversion if needed.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::getIndexBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves or converts index buffer for drawing.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::convertIndexBuffer
methods.description: Converts index buffer to supported format, possibly on GPU.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::streamIndexBufferFromClient
methods.description: Streams index data from client memory into GPU buffer.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::convertVertexBuffer
methods.description: Converts vertex buffer to tightly packed format, possibly on GPU.

methods.name: VertexArrayMtl::convertVertexBufferCPU
methods.description: Performs CPU-based vertex buffer conversion to packed format.
